headline:
Your connection,
encrypted.
description: Encrypt traffic between your device and the VPN server on café, hotel, or travel Wi-Fi. Set up your computer and phone, then see your usage in one place.
benefitsTitle: From public Wi-Fi to everyday browsing
privacyBody: At a café, hotel, or airport, a VPN encrypts traffic between your device and the VPN server.
routesBody: View and switch between the routes included in your subscription in a compatible client. Availability depends on your subscription.
devicesBody: Import your subscription into a compatible client using the setup guide. Check data usage and expiration in your account.
planBody: Compare pricing, billing periods, data and device limits before you choose.

comparison.title: Compare prices and benefits
comparison.swipe: Swipe to compare all prices and benefits
comparison.note: Daily equivalents are for comparison: 30 days per month, 90 days per quarter, 365 days per year, and 3 days for the trial. Plans are paid upfront for the selected period; actual terms follow the calendar. Coupons and payment fees are shown at checkout.
